statement: Plücker’s 1834 note announces that a general smooth complex plane quartic has 28 bitangent lines; the proof details are deferred.

answer.text: Announced generic complex count: 28 bitangent lines.

source.location: Displayed formula p. 107 and quartic paragraph p. 108

notes: Specialize the announced general formula to d=4; the quartic paragraph on p. 108 also states 28 explicitly. The 1834 note is an announcement with proof details deferred, so the historical evidence remains an announced result.
